name: inventory-menu-ui
description: Validate the authoritative Inventory modal, owned-item filtering, stable duplicate-pet slot actions, desktop and compact layout contracts, and clean modal restoration.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='Inventory QA Desktop 1366x768' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=1366,Height=768,PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Desktop} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.3) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild('PunchWallAutomation') c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Coins=50000,OwnedFistsJSON='["Starter Glove","Boxing Glove"]',OwnedPremiumFistsJSON='["Crimson Vanguard Fist"]',EquippedFist='Starter Glove',PetInventoryJSON='["Crystal Fox","Crystal Fox","Miner Cat"]',EquippedPetsJSON='["Crystal Fox"]',DiscoveredPetsJSON='["Crystal Fox","Miner Cat"]',LockedPetsJSON='["slot:2"]',OwnedHonorItemsJSON='["Vanguard Trail"]',EquippedHonorItem='Vanguard Trail'}) local boost=c:Invoke('BuyShopBoost','CoinBoost') return H:JSONEncode({ok=boost.ok==true,coins=boost.Coins,equipped=boost.EquippedFist,inventory=boost.PetInventoryJSON,locked=boost.LockedPetsJSON})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') a:Invoke('OpenInventory') task.wait(.3) local s=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') local allowed={['fist:Starter Glove']=true,['fist:Boxing Glove']=true,['fist:Crimson Vanguard Fist']=true,['pet:slot:1']=true,['pet:slot:2']=true,['pet:slot:3']=true,['honor:Vanguard Trail']=true,['boost:CoinBoost']=true} local unexpected={} for _,key in ipairs(s.visibleKeys or {}) do if not allowed[key] then table.insert(unexpected,key) end end local names=string.upper(table.concat(s.visibleNames or {},'|')) local noFake=not names:find('VIP PASS',1,true) and not names:find('STEEL INGOT',1,true) and not names:find('GOLD ORE',1,true) and not names:find('AUTO TRAIN',1,true) and not names:find('EXTRA SLOTS',1,true) and not names:find('COIN MAGNET',1,true) local starter=table.find(s.visibleKeys or {},'fist:Starter Glove')~=nil local layout=s.layout or {} local art=s.art or {} local capacity=s.capacity or {} return H:JSONEncode({ok=s.ok==true and s.visible==true and s.category=='All' and #unexpected==0 and noFake and starter and capacity.used==3 and capacity.max==60 and s.hudHidden==true and layout.compact==false and (layout.minTouchTarget or 0)>=44 and layout.allTextFits==true and layout.insideSafeArea==true and layout.noOverlap==true and art.magentaFree==true and art.checkerboardFree==true,visible=#(s.visibleKeys or {}),unexpected=unexpected,noFake=noFake,starter=starter,used=capacity.used,max=capacity.max,hudHidden=s.hudHidden,compact=layout.compact,minTouch=layout.minTouchTarget,textFits=layout.allTextFits,safe=layout.insideSafeArea,noOverlap=layout.noOverlap,artMode=art.mode,magentaFree=art.magentaFree,checkerboardFree=art.checkerboardFree})

steps.label: desktop inventory shows only authoritative owned items

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Fists') a:Invoke('SetInventoryRarity','All') a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','boxing') task.wait(.15) local filtered=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem','fist:Boxing Glove') task.wait(.1) local s=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') local d=s.selected or {} local canEquip=table.find(d.actions or {},'Equip')~=nil return H:JSONEncode({ok=#(filtered.visibleKeys or {})==1 and filtered.visibleKeys[1]=='fist:Boxing Glove' and d.key=='fist:Boxing Glove' and d.kind=='Fist' and d.name=='Boxing Glove' and type(d.description)=='string' and d.description~='' and canEquip,category=filtered.category,search=filtered.search,count=#(filtered.visibleKeys or {}),key=d.key,kind=d.kind,name=d.name,description=d.description,canEquip=canEquip})

steps.label: search selects an authoritative fist detail

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','') a:Invoke('SetInventoryRarity','All') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Honor') local honor=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Boosts') local boosts=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') local honorOnly=#(honor.visibleKeys or {})==1 and honor.visibleKeys[1]=='honor:Vanguard Trail' local boostOnly=#(boosts.visibleKeys or {})==1 and boosts.visibleKeys[1]=='boost:CoinBoost' return H:JSONEncode({ok=honorOnly and boostOnly,honor=honor.visibleKeys,boosts=boosts.visibleKeys})

steps.label: Honor and active Boost categories filter accurately

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Pets') a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','crystal') a:Invoke('SetInventoryRarity','Epic') local filtered=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem','pet:slot:2') local s=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') local d=s.selected or {} local canUnlock=table.find(d.actions or {},'Unlock')~=nil local canDelete=table.find(d.actions or {},'Delete')~=nil local keys=filtered.visibleKeys or {} return H:JSONEncode({ok=#keys==2 and table.find(keys,'pet:slot:1')~=nil and table.find(keys,'pet:slot:2')~=nil and d.key=='pet:slot:2' and d.kind=='Pet' and d.name=='Crystal Fox' and d.slot==2 and d.locked==true and canUnlock and not canDelete,count=#keys,keys=keys,key=d.key,name=d.name,slot=d.slot,locked=d.locked,canUnlock=canUnlock,canDelete=canDelete,rarity=filtered.rarity,search=filtered.search})

steps.label: duplicate pets retain independent slot identity and lock

args.code: local a=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('InvokeInventoryAction',{action='Unlock',key='pet:slot:2'}) task.wait(.25) local unlocked=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') a:Invoke('InvokeInventoryAction',{action='Lock',key='pet:slot:2'}) task.wait(.25) local relocked=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem','pet:slot:1') a:Invoke('InvokeInventoryAction',{action='Delete',key='pet:slot:1'}) return unlocked.selected and unlocked.selected.locked==false and relocked.selected and relocked.selected.locked==true

steps.label: unlock relock and delete target exact duplicate slots

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local before={inventory=p.RPGStats.PetInventoryJSON.Value,locked=p.RPGStats.LockedPetsJSON.Value,equipped=p.RPGStats.EquippedPetsJSON.Value} local ok=before.inventory=='["Crystal Fox","Miner Cat"]' and before.locked=='["slot:1"]' and before.equipped=='[]' local reset=c:Invoke('Reset') return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,inventory=before.inventory,locked=before.locked,equipped=before.equipped,reset=reset.ok==true})

steps.label: server confirms slot shift then immediately resets test deletion

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('CloseInventory') task.wait(.2) local s=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') local reference=g:FindFirstChild('PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD') return H:JSONEncode({ok=s.visible==false and s.hudHidden==false and reference and reference.Visible==true,visible=s.visible,hudHidden=s.hudHidden,hudVisible=reference and reference.Visible})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') S:StopSimulationAsync() local n='Inventory QA Phone 740x360' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=740,Height=360,PixelDensity=326,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Phone} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetOrientationAsync(Enum.ScreenOrientation.LandscapeLeft) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.3) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

local c=game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild('PunchWallAutomation') c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{OwnedFistsJSON='["Starter Glove","Boxing Glove"]',EquippedFist='Starter Glove',PetInventoryJSON='["Crystal Fox","Crystal Fox","Miner Cat"]',EquippedPetsJSON='["Crystal Fox"]',DiscoveredPetsJSON='["Crystal Fox","Miner Cat"]',LockedPetsJSON='["slot:2"]',OwnedHonorItemsJSON='["Vanguard Trail"]',EquippedHonorItem='Vanguard Trail'}) return true

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') a:Invoke('OpenInventory') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Pets') a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','crystal') a:Invoke('SetInventoryRarity','Epic') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem','pet:slot:2') task.wait(.3) local s=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') local l=s.layout or {} local art=s.art or {} local drawer=g:FindFirstChild('CompactDetailDrawer',true) return H:JSONEncode({ok=s.visible==true and l.compact==true and (l.columns==2 or l.columns==3) and (l.minTouchTarget or 0)>=44 and l.allTextFits==true and l.insideSafeArea==true and l.noOverlap==true and (l.detailMode=='Drawer' or (drawer and drawer.Visible==true)) and art.magentaFree==true and art.checkerboardFree==true and s.selected and s.selected.key=='pet:slot:2',compact=l.compact,columns=l.columns,minTouch=l.minTouchTarget,textFits=l.allTextFits,safe=l.insideSafeArea,noOverlap=l.noOverlap,detailMode=l.detailMode,drawer=drawer and drawer.Visible,key=s.selected and s.selected.key,magentaFree=art.magentaFree,checkerboardFree=art.checkerboardFree})

steps.label: compact drawer remains touch safe and readable

args.code: local a=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('CloseInventory') local s=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') return s.visible==false and s.hudHidden==false

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') S:StopSimulationAsync() task.wait(.2) local names={['Inventory QA Desktop 1366x768']=true,['Inventory QA Phone 740x360']=true} local removed=0 for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if names[info.Name] and info.IsCustom then S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) removed+=1 end end return H:JSONEncode({default=S:GetDeviceAsync()=='default',removed=removed})

local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) local names={['Inventory QA Desktop 1366x768']=true,['Inventory QA Phone 740x360']=true} for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if names[info.Name] and info.IsCustom then pcall(function() S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) end) end end return true
